name: E2E dogfood 154: greets back
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'hi'. Once Langy has answered, write exactly: 'who are you?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy answers the greeting with a short, friendly reply that introduces itself as Langy or the LangWatch assistant.
The greeting reply names at least one concrete thing Langy can help with (for example traces, evaluations, prompts, or scenarios).
Langy does NOT decline the greeting or the "who are you?" question, in any wording, and does not tell the user it is out of scope.
Langy does not dump internal tool mechanics, CLI commands, or its own rule list in response to a plain greeting.

parameters.name: world
parameters.description: Which matrix world the setup hook builds
